distribution.narrative: Baseline review: 殷蕙芬等 (1984) records Xinjiang (新疆；喀什). 黄复生等 (2015) retains Xinjiang with no province-level addition or omission. No baseline occurrence conflict is evident.

host_note: 殷蕙芬等 (1984) reports 梅，杏，樱桃 / Prunus mume, Prunus armeniaca, Prunus pseudocerasus. 黄复生等 (2015) retains those hosts and adds 李属，苹果属，梨属，山楂属，榅桲属，榆属 / Prunus spp., Malus spp., Pyrus sp., Crataegus spp., Cydonia sp., Ulmus spp. The expanded host set should be traced to primary or later literature before being treated as the reviewed current host summary.
taxonomy_summary: The current accepted identity is Scolytus rugulosus (Müller, 1818).
